Custom apparel for all of New Jersey

Meadow Prints & Embroidery is based in Monmouth County and serves businesses, crews, teams and schools all over New Jersey. We screen print and embroider custom t-shirts, work shirts, hoodies, hats and uniforms, and deliver them wherever you are in the state. Here are some of the towns we work with most.

What we do

Services across New Jersey

Screen Printing

Bold, durable prints that get more affordable per shirt as the order grows.

Custom Embroidery

Stitched logos for polos, hats, jackets and bags with a premium finish.

Custom T-Shirts

Tees for teams, events and businesses, from one-offs to hundreds.

Hats & Caps

Truckers, snapbacks and beanies, embroidered or patched.

Hoodies & Outerwear

Hoodies, crews, quarter-zips and jackets for crews and fans.

Team & Spirit Wear

Uniforms, warmups and fan gear with names and numbers.
